style: 2026-10-20 user correction: chunky simple casual mechanics; detail-heavy versions rejected

basic.prompt:
A transparent sprite atlas for a cheerful casual mobile shooter. Exactly 12 separate equipment icons, a strict 4 columns x 3 rows grid, huge empty transparent gutters. Each icon fills only 60% of its cell.
Art direction: VERY SIMPLE chunky cartoon game items, like a casual survivors mobile game inventory. Bold thick black outer outline, 2 or 3 broad flat colors, one big identifying feature. Toy-like and rounded. Designed to read at 48 pixels. STRICT TOP VIEW. No gradients, no metallic rendering, no panel seams, no rivets, no micro-details, no realistic machinery, no extra decorations. No text, no tiles or frames.
Row 1: single long blue cannon barrel on a short grey block, pointing up; squat twin orange rocket tubes pointing up; round blue sensor with ONE large cyan lens; chunky blue U-shaped magnetic scanner.
Row 2: chunky grey hexagon with ONE large yellow center; two joined cyan battery blocks; single broad blue-grey armor slab; single green armor slab with ONE cream repair cross.
Row 3: chunky blue ring shield generator; pair of simple green emergency cylinders; squat blue twin thruster with two downward exhaust holes; wide orange thruster with ONE broad downward exhaust hole.
Make these feel as simple and charming as bold cartoon belt, boot and armor inventory icons. Mechanical identity comes from silhouette only. All components connected within each item.

boss.prompt:
Transparent sprite atlas of EXACTLY 20 simple cartoon spaceship equipment items, strict 4 columns x 5 rows, very wide transparent gutters, each sprite inside middle 60% of its cell. No text, no frames.
Bold casual mobile survivors-game inventory artwork: thick BLACK outlines, chunky rounded shapes, two main flat colors and one accent, at most 5 large shapes per item. Minimal cute toy machinery, readable at 48 pixels. Strict TOP VIEW. NO panel lines, bolts, tiny vents, filigree, gears, realism, metallic gradients, ornament clusters. Each item's silhouette is one connected object.
Items occur in ten pairs, each pair a broad ARMOR PLATE followed by a squat downward-facing THRUSTER. Armor is ONE solid slab with one simple motif; thruster is ONE chunky housing with ONE large dark exhaust opening. Do not draw full spaceships.
Read in row-major order:
Row1: orange square armor / orange square thruster / lavender crescent armor / lavender crescent thruster.
Row2: yellow three-point crown armor / yellow three-point crown thruster / cyan wedge armor / cyan wedge thruster.
Row3: green hexagon armor / green hexagon thruster / red box armor / red box thruster.
Row4: amber sun-disc armor / amber sun-disc thruster / teal wave armor / teal wave thruster.
Row5: purple diamond armor / purple diamond thruster / ivory-and-purple crescent armor / ivory-and-purple crescent thruster.
Use only a single large motif for each pair. Make the overall art as simple as a cartoon belt or boot icon, not a detailed science-fiction concept design.
